common_rules.confirmation: Only after the signal candle is complete; all indicator inputs include that candle and no future candles.
common_rules.entry: Next signal-timeframe candle open, using the corresponding OKX 1m open as a proxy for executable Hyperliquid BBO mid.
common_rules.time_stop: Close full size at the close of time_bars bars, counting the entry bar as bar 1; never widen stop; no trailing or partial exits.
common_rules.position_policy: One position per asset per setup, no pyramiding, ignore new signals while occupied; BTC and ETH may overlap. Opposite signals do not exit/reverse an open trade.
common_rules.trend_filter_if_selected: Long: signal close > EMA100 and EMA100 > prior EMA100. Short: signal close < EMA100 and EMA100 < prior EMA100, all on the selected timeframe.
common_rules.session_filter: None: 24/7 UTC. Unknown off-hours curve schedule is bracketed by separate payout scenarios.
common_rules.research_risk_normalization: Each trade risks 0.25% of initial account equity at its planned stop. Fixed dollar R, no compounding. Margin fraction = 0.0025 / (100 × stop_fraction).
do_not_trade: This study establishes no positive 100x edge: setups are specifications for observation, not deployment recommendations.
Skip unconfirmed/missing candles, simultaneous opposing signals, the gap filter failure, or a position already open in that asset.

Operationally skip when actual displayed bust is not farther away than the stop, when the relayer cannot support prompt closes, or when opens are paused/capped. These unavailable protocol states were not historical filters.

selection_design.objective: pooled mean net R - 0.5 * sample standard deviation(R)/sqrt(n); at least max(3,min_n//5) trades per asset
selection_design.selection: top five eligible training candidates, then highest validation objective; if none eligible, highest available score with explicit insufficient-sample flag

protocol.fidelity: Documented contract-set-2 mathematical payout scenario, not a byte-exact or historical onchain replay.
protocol.win_formula: m=max(0, directional_move - 0.00002 - holdback); net_notional_return=m*(1-base_rate)/(1+1/(m*rate_multiplier)+reference_notional/(1e6*m*position_multiplier))*0.98, or 0 if m=0.
protocol.loss_formula: Signed directional return, no additional trader fee; at/past bust lose full margin: net_notional_return=-0.01.
protocol.bust_limit: Docs only approximate a 5bp buffer. Main scenario uses 0.95% adverse price distance; 0.90% and 1.00% sensitivities are included.
protocol.intraminute_policy: If a live position’s 1m candle touches bust, assume keeper beats stop. Otherwise stop before target when both touched. Gaps use open for adverse fills; favorable target gaps receive target only.
protocol.paper_reason: No historical supply, LP balance/insolvency clock, exact c, funding origin, or queued settlement state; no realizable token price. Documented emission function is implemented with explicit state inputs.
